SOURCE tools/decomp/hybrid.py
SHA256 db53c1eb0d747e2a49f7644cccd587fd44cff0a43f3624fcf58195a7ae659bdd

0001: #!/usr/bin/env python3
0002: """Hybrid build: decompiled TUs linked into the original game process.
0003: 
0004: Every decomp/src/**/*.cpp is compiled with the original toolchain to assembly.
0005: Data the original already owns (globals, TU-local statics, vtables, RTTI, guard
0006: variables) is redirected to its original address, so decompiled code operates on
0007: the game's real objects; the TU's static constructors are dropped because the
0008: original already ran them. The objects are linked at a fixed address within
0009: rel32 range of the non-PIE executable; every other symbol resolves to the
0010: original function, data or PLT entry. Functions of a decompiled TU replace the
0011: original ones through 5-byte jumps installed by decomp/hybrid/loader.c.
0012: 
0013:     python3 tools/decomp/hybrid.py build
0014:     python3 tools/decomp/hybrid.py selftest        # original vs decomp, exits before main
0015:     python3 tools/decomp/hybrid.py run [-- ARGS]   # play with decompiled code (explicit task)
0016: """
0017: from __future__ import annotations
0018: 
0019: import argparse
0020: import hashlib
0021: import json
0022: import os
0023: from pathlib import Path
0024: import re
0025: import shutil
0026: import subprocess
0027: import sys
0028: import tempfile
0029: 
0030: sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
0031: import elfdb  # noqa: E402
0032: import elfimage  # noqa: E402
0033: import objdiff  # noqa: E402
0034: import toolchain  # noqa: E402
0035: 
0036: ROOT = elfdb.ROOT
0037: SRC = ROOT / "decomp" / "src"
0038: HYBRID = ROOT / "decomp" / "hybrid"
0039: TESTS = HYBRID / "tests"
0040: OUT = ROOT / "build-decomp" / "hybrid"
0041: # Within rel32 and imm32 reach of the executable (0x400000..0x1600000), and above
0042: # the brk heap: on x86-64 the kernel places it up to 1 GiB past the end of .bss.
0043: BLOB_BASE = 0x60000000
0044: 
0045: LINKER_SCRIPT = """\
0046: SECTIONS
0047: {{
0048:   . = {base:#x};
0049:   __tlhybrid_text_start = .;
0050:   .text : {{ *(.text .text.* .gnu.linkonce.t.*) }}
0051:   __tlhybrid_text_end = .;
0052:   . = ALIGN(4096);
0053:   .rodata : {{ *(.rodata .rodata.* .gnu.linkonce.r.*) }}
0054:   .eh_frame : {{ KEEP(*(.eh_frame)) LONG(0) }}
0055:   .gcc_except_table : {{ *(.gcc_except_table .gcc_except_table.*) }}
0056:   .tlhybrid.hooks : {{ KEEP(*(.tlhybrid.hooks)) }}
0057:   .tlhybrid.tests : {{ KEEP(*(.tlhybrid.tests)) }}
0058:   .tlhybrid.imports : {{ KEEP(*(.tlhybrid.imports)) }}
0059:   .tlhybrid.copies : {{ KEEP(*(.tlhybrid.copies)) }}
0060:   . = ALIGN(4096);
0061:   .data : {{ *(.data .data.* .gnu.linkonce.d.* .data.rel.ro .data.rel.ro.*) }}
0062:   .tlhybrid.ctors : {{ KEEP(*(.ctors)) }}
0063:   .bss : {{ *(.bss .bss.* .gnu.linkonce.b.*) *(COMMON) }}
0064:   /DISCARD/ : {{ *(.note.GNU-stack) *(.comment) *(.dtors) *(.jcr) *(.eh_frame_hdr) }}
0065: }}
0066: INCLUDE originals.ld
0067: """
0068: 
0069: 
0070: # Symbols the linker script defines for the blob's own code.
0071: LINKER_DEFINED = {"__tlhybrid_text_start", "__tlhybrid_text_end"}
0072: 
0073: 
0074: class Context:
0075:     def __init__(self):
0076:         self.db = elfdb.load_db()
0077:         self.image = elfimage.load(elfdb.default_elf())
0078:         self.functions = {int(a, 16): f for a, f in self.db["functions"].items()}
0079:         self.order = sorted(self.functions)
0080:         self.global_data = {}
0081:         self.local_data = {}
0082:         for g in self.db["globals"]:
0083:             address = int(g["address"], 16)
0084:             if g["bind"] == "local":
0085:                 self.local_data.setdefault(g["file"], {})[g["name"]] = address
0086:             else:
0087:                 self.global_data[g["name"]] = address
0088: 
0089:     def tu_functions(self, tu):
0090:         names = {}
0091:         for address, f in self.functions.items():
0092:             if f["tu"] == tu["id"]:
0093:                 for name in f["names"]:
0094:                     names[name] = f
0095:         return names
0096: 
0097: 
0098: # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
0099: # Assembly rewrite
0100: 
0101: 
0102: SECTION_DIRECTIVE = re.compile(r"^\s*\.(text|data|bss|section\s+([^,\s]+).*|previous|pushsection\s+([^,\s]+).*|popsection)\s*$")
0103: 
0104: 
0105: def rewrite_assembly(text, redirect, drop_ctors):
0106:     """Redirect owned data to original addresses; optionally drop .ctors entries."""
0107:     lines = text.splitlines()
0108:     objects = set()
0109:     for line in lines:
0110:         m = re.match(r"^\s*\.type\s+([^,\s]+),\s*@object", line)
0111:         if m:
0112:             objects.add(m.group(1))
0113:         m = re.match(r"^\s*\.(?:comm|lcomm)\s+([^,\s]+),", line)
0114:         if m:
0115:             objects.add(m.group(1))
0116:     targets = {name: redirect[name] for name in objects if name in redirect}
0117:     out, section, stack, dead = [], ".text", [], 0
0118:     previous = ".text"
0119:     for line in lines:
0120:         m = SECTION_DIRECTIVE.match(line)
0121:         if m:
0122:             word = m.group(1).split()[0]
0123:             if word in ("text", "data", "bss"):
0124:                 previous, section = section, "." + word
0125:             elif word == "section":
0126:                 previous, section = section, m.group(2)
0127:             elif word == "previous":
0128:                 previous, section = section, previous
0129:             elif word == "pushsection":
0130:                 stack.append(section)
0131:                 section = m.group(3)
0132:             elif word == "popsection":
0133:                 section = stack.pop()
0134:             out.append(line)
0135:             continue
0136:         if drop_ctors and section == ".ctors" and re.match(r"^\s*\.quad\s", line):
0137:             continue
0138:         label = re.match(r"^([^\s:.][^\s:]*):\s*$", line)
0139:         if label and label.group(1) in targets:
0140:             out.append(f".Ltlhybrid_dead_{dead}:")
0141:             dead += 1
0142:             continue
0143:         comm = re.match(r"^\s*\.(?:comm|lcomm)\s+([^,\s]+),", line)
0144:         if comm and comm.group(1) in targets:
0145:             continue
0146:         out.append(line)
0147:     for name, address in sorted(targets.items()):
0148:         out.append(f"\t.set\t{name}, {address:#x}")
0149:     return "\n".join(out) + "\n", sorted(targets)
0150: 
0151: 
0152: # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
0153: 
0154: 
0155: def defined_functions(obj_path):
0156:     obj = elfimage.load_object(obj_path)
0157:     return [(s.name, s.bind) for s in obj.symbols if s.type == elfimage.STT_FUNC and s.defined]
0158: 
0159: 
0160: def undefined_symbols(obj_path):
0161:     obj = elfimage.load_object(obj_path)
0162:     return {s.name for s in obj.symbols if not s.defined and s.name}
0163: 
0164: 
0165: def defined_symbols(obj_path):
0166:     obj = elfimage.load_object(obj_path)
0167:     return {s.name for s in obj.symbols if s.defined and s.name and s.bind != elfimage.STB_LOCAL}
0168: 
0169: 
0170: def patch_window_ok(ctx, address):
0171:     """5-byte jmp must fit before the next function and not hit an internal branch target."""
0172:     i = ctx.order.index(address)
0173:     nxt = ctx.order[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(ctx.order) else address + ctx.functions[address]["size"]
0174:     if nxt - address < 5:
0175:         return "function slot shorter than 5 bytes"
0176:     f = ctx.functions[address]
0177:     insns = objdiff.parse_insns(objdiff.run_objdump([f"--start-address={address:#x}",
0178:                                                      f"--stop-address={address + f['size']:#x}",
0179:                                                      str(ctx.image.path)]))
0180:     for _, mnemonic, operands in insns:
0181:         m = re.match(r"^([0-9a-f]+) <", operands)
0182:         if m and mnemonic.startswith(("j", "loop", "call")):
0183:             target = int(m.group(1), 16)
0184:             if address < target < address + 5:
0185:                 return f"internal branch into the patched bytes ({target:#x})"
0186:     return None
0187: 
0188: 
0189: def originals_script(ctx, extra_aliases):
0190:     lines = []
0191:     seen = set()
0192: 
0193:     def provide(name, address):
0194:         if name and name not in seen and '"' not in name:
0195:             seen.add(name)
0196:             lines.append(f'PROVIDE("{name}" = {address:#x});')
0197: 
0198:     local_counts = {}
0199:     for f in ctx.functions.values():
0200:         for name, bind in zip(f["names"], f["bind"]):
0201:             if bind == "local":
0202:                 local_counts[name] = local_counts.get(name, 0) + 1
0203:     for address, f in sorted(ctx.functions.items()):
0204:         for name, bind in zip(f["names"], f["bind"]):
0205:             if bind != "local":
0206:                 provide(name, address)
0207:             if bind != "local" or local_counts.get(name) == 1:
0208:                 provide("__tlorig_" + name, address)
0209:     for name, address in sorted(ctx.global_data.items()):
0210:         provide(name, address)
0211:     # Unique local data (e.g. the hidden __dso_handle) is unambiguous by name.
0212:     local_data_counts = {}
0213:     for symbols in ctx.local_data.values():
0214:         for name in symbols:
0215:             local_data_counts[name] = local_data_counts.get(name, 0) + 1
0216:     for symbols in ctx.local_data.values():
0217:         for name, address in symbols.items():
0218:             if local_data_counts[name] == 1:
0219:                 provide(name, address)
0220:     for address, name in sorted(ctx.image.plt.items()):
0221:         provide(name.split("@")[0], address)
0222:     for s in ctx.image.dynsyms:
0223:         if s.defined and s.value and s.name:
0224:             provide(s.name.split("@")[0], s.value)
0225:     for name, address in extra_aliases:
0226:         provide(name, address)
0227:     return "\n".join(lines) + "\n", seen
0228: 
0229: 
0230: def hooks_assembly(hooks):
0231:     out = ["\t.section .tlhybrid.hooks,\"a\",@progbits", "\t.align 8"]
0232:     names = ["\t.section .rodata.tlhybrid_names,\"a\",@progbits"]
0233:     for i, hook in enumerate(hooks):
0234:         out.append(f"\t.quad {hook['original']:#x}, {hook['symbol']}, .Ltlhybrid_name_{i}")
0235:         out.append("\t.byte " + ", ".join(f"{b:#x}" for b in hook["expected"]))
0236:         names.append(f".Ltlhybrid_name_{i}:\n\t.string \"{hook['demangled'][:200]}\"")
0237:     return "\n".join(out + names) + "\n"
0238: 
0239: 
0240: C_LOCALE = {**os.environ, "LC_ALL": "C"}
0241: 
0242: 
0243: def needed_libraries(elf):
0244:     """Paths of the executable's DT_NEEDED libraries, searched as the run sets LD_LIBRARY_PATH
0245:     (the game's lib64, the game directory) and then as the system linker would."""
0246:     game = Path(elf).parent
0247:     dynamic = subprocess.run(["readelf", "-d", "-W", str(elf)], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
0248:                              env=C_LOCALE).stdout
0249:     system = {}
0250:     for line in subprocess.run([shutil.which("ldconfig") or "/sbin/ldconfig", "-p"], capture_output=True, text=True, env=C_LOCALE).stdout.splitlines():
0251:         m = re.match(r"\s+(\S+) \(([^)]*)\) => (\S+)", line)
0252:         if m and "x86-64" in m.group(2):
0253:             system.setdefault(m.group(1), m.group(3))
0254:     out = []
0255:     for name in re.findall(r"\(NEEDED\)\s+Shared library: \[([^\]]+)\]", dynamic):
0256:         for candidate in (game / "lib64" / name, game / name, Path(system.get(name, "/nonexistent"))):
0257:             if candidate.exists():
0258:                 out.append(candidate)
0259:                 break
0260:     return out
0261: 
0262: 
0263: def library_objects(elf, names):
0264:     """name -> size of the data objects among names, from the libraries' dynamic symbols."""
0265:     wanted, found = set(names), {}
0266:     for lib in needed_libraries(elf):
0267:         text = subprocess.run(["readelf", "--dyn-syms", "-W", str(lib)], capture_output=True, text=True,
0268:                               env=C_LOCALE).stdout
0269:         for line in text.splitlines():
0270:             parts = line.split()
0271:             if len(parts) < 8 or parts[3] not in ("OBJECT", "TLS") or parts[6] == "UND":
0272:                 continue
0273:             name = parts[7].split("@")[0]
0274:             if name in wanted and name not in found:
0275:                 found[name] = int(parts[2], 16) if parts[2].startswith("0x") else int(parts[2])
0276:     return found
0277: 
0278: 
0279: # Library data a copy may stand for: RTTI and vtables are never written, and type_info
0280: # equality falls back to the name (libstdc++ __GXX_MERGED_TYPEINFO_NAMES == 0).
0281: COPYABLE = ("_ZTI", "_ZTS", "_ZTV", "_ZTT")
0282: 
0283: 
0284: def imports_assembly(names, objects=None):
0285:     """Library symbols the original executable never imported. A function becomes a jump
0286:     through a slot the loader fills. Code addresses data with 32-bit absolute relocations,
0287:     so an object needs a place in the blob, which the loader fills with the library's bytes
0288:     (what a COPY relocation would do for the executable)."""
0289:     objects = objects or {}
0290:     out = ["\t.text"]
0291:     data = ["\t.data", "\t.align 8"]
0292:     table = ["\t.section .tlhybrid.imports,\"a\",@progbits", "\t.align 8"]
0293:     strings = ["\t.section .rodata.tlhybrid_imports,\"a\",@progbits"]
0294:     copies = ["\t.section .tlhybrid.copies,\"a\",@progbits", "\t.align 8"]
0295:     for i, name in enumerate(sorted(names)):
0296:         strings.append(f".Ltlhybrid_import_{i}:\n\t.string \"{name}\"")
0297:         if name in objects:
0298:             data += ["\t.align 16", f"\t.globl {name}", f"\t.type {name}, @object", f"\t.size {name}, {objects[name]}",
0299:                      f"{name}:", f"\t.zero {objects[name]}"]
0300:             copies.append(f"\t.quad .Ltlhybrid_import_{i}, {name}, {objects[name]}")
0301:             continue
0302:         out += [f"\t.globl {name}", f"\t.type {name}, @function", f"{name}:",
0303:                 f"\tjmp *.Ltlhybrid_slot_{i}(%rip)"]
0304:         data.append(f".Ltlhybrid_slot_{i}:\n\t.quad 0")
0305:         table.append(f"\t.quad .Ltlhybrid_import_{i}, .Ltlhybrid_slot_{i}")
0306:     return "\n".join(out + data + table + copies + strings) + "\n"
0307: 
0308: 
0309: def build(out=OUT, verbose=True, src=SRC, tests=None):
0310:     import publication
0311:     with publication.tree_lock():
0312:         return _build(out, verbose, src, tests)
0313: 
0314: 
0315: def _build(out=OUT, verbose=True, src=SRC, tests=None):
0316:     """src: decompiled sources (a mutated copy for tools/decomp/mutate.py);
0317:     tests: test sources, by default decomp/hybrid/tests plus generated
0318:     autotests when OTL_AUTOTEST=1."""
0319:     ctx = Context()
0320:     out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
0321:     objects, hooks, notes = [], [], []
0322:     production_undefined, production_defined = set(), set()
0323:     data_redirects, omitted_initializers, source_versions = {}, {}, {}
0324:     if tests is None:
0325:         tests = sorted(TESTS.glob("*.cpp"))
0326:         if os.environ.get("OTL_AUTOTEST"):
0327:             # Generated differential tests (tools/decomp/autotest.py).
0328:             tests += sorted((ROOT / "build-decomp" / "hybrid" / "autotests").glob("*.cpp"))
0329:     units = [(p, False) for p in sorted(Path(src).rglob("*.cpp"))] + [(p, True) for p in tests]
0330: 
0331:     def compile_unit(unit):
0332:         source, is_test = unit
0333:         asm = out / f"{'test_' if is_test else ''}{source.stem}.s"
0334:         toolchain.compile_source(source, asm, ["-I", str(HYBRID)], assembly=True)
0335:     toolchain.parallel_map(compile_unit, units)
0336:     for source, is_test in units:
0337:         tu = None if is_test else objdiff.tu_for_source(ctx.db, source)
0338:         if not is_test and tu is None:
0339:             raise SystemExit(f"{source}: no unique original TU named {source.name}")
0340:         stem = ("test_" if is_test else "") + source.stem
0341:         asm = out / f"{stem}.s"
0342:         redirect = dict(ctx.global_data)
0343:         if tu:
0344:             redirect.update(ctx.local_data.get(tu["name"], {}))
0345:         text, redirected = rewrite_assembly(asm.read_text(), redirect, drop_ctors=not is_test)
0346:         if not is_test:
0347:             relative = str(source.relative_to(ROOT))
0348:             source_versions[relative] = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
0349:             data_redirects[relative] = sorted(redirected)
0350:             omitted_initializers[relative] = sorted(set(re.findall(
0351:                 r"\.type\s+([^,\s]*(?:_GLOBAL__I_|__static_initialization)[^,\s]*),\s*@function", asm.read_text())))
0352:         patched = out / f"{stem}.hybrid.s"
0353:         patched.write_text(text)
0354:         obj = out / f"{stem}.o"
0355:         toolchain.assemble(patched, obj)
0356:         objects.append(obj)
0357:         if not is_test:
0358:             production_defined |= defined_symbols(obj)
0359:             production_undefined |= undefined_symbols(obj)
0360:         unit_hooks = 0
0361:         if tu:
0362:             owned = ctx.tu_functions(tu)
0363:             for name, bind in defined_functions(obj):
0364:                 f = owned.get(name)
0365:                 if not f or f["kind"] == "compiler":
0366:                     continue
0367:                 address = int(f["address"], 16)
0368:                 if any(h["original"] == address for h in hooks):
0369:                     continue
0370:                 problem = patch_window_ok(ctx, address)
0371:                 if problem:
0372:                     notes.append(f"not hooked {f['demangled']}: {problem}")
0373:                     continue
0374:                 hooks.append({"original": address, "symbol": name, "demangled": f["demangled"],
0375:                               "expected": list(ctx.image.read(address, 8)), "unit": str(source.relative_to(ROOT))})
0376:                 unit_hooks += 1
0377:         if verbose:
0378:             print(f"  {source.relative_to(ROOT)}: {len(redirected)} data symbols redirected, {unit_hooks} hooks")
0379: 
0380:     hooks_s = out / "hooks.s"
0381:     hooks_s.write_text(hooks_assembly(hooks))
0382:     toolchain.assemble(hooks_s, out / "hooks.o")
0383:     script, provided = originals_script(ctx, [])
0384:     (out / "originals.ld").write_text(script)
0385:     defined = set()
0386:     undefined = set()
0387:     for obj in objects + [out / "hooks.o"]:
0388:         defined |= defined_symbols(obj)
0389:         undefined |= undefined_symbols(obj)
0390:     missing = sorted(n for n in undefined - defined - provided - LINKER_DEFINED if not n.startswith(".L"))
0391:     absent = objdiff.unknown_members(ctx.db, objdiff.image_symbol_names(ctx.image), missing)
0392:     if absent:
0393:         raise SystemExit("the decompiled code calls members the original does not have:\n" + "\n".join(
0394:             f"  {n}; the original has: {'; '.join(objdiff.known_overloads(ctx.db, n)) or 'no such member'}"
0395:             for n in absent))
0396:     copies = library_objects(ctx.image.path, missing)
0397:     shared = sorted(n for n in copies if not n.startswith(COPYABLE))
0398:     if shared:
0399:         raise SystemExit("the decompiled code uses library data the original never imported; a copy in the "
0400:                          "blob would be a different object:\n" + "\n".join(f"  {n}" for n in shared))
0401:     imports_s = out / "imports.s"
0402:     imports_s.write_text(imports_assembly(missing, copies))
0403:     toolchain.assemble(imports_s, out / "imports.o")
0404:     (out / "hybrid.ld").write_text(LINKER_SCRIPT.format(base=BLOB_BASE))
0405:     blob = out / "tlhybrid-blob.elf"
0406:     subprocess.run(["ld", "-nostdlib", "-static", "-e", "0", "--build-id=none", "-z", "noexecstack",
0407:                     "-z", "max-page-size=4096", "--no-warn-rwx-segments", "-T", "hybrid.ld", "-o", blob.name,
0408:                     *[o.name for o in objects], "hooks.o", "imports.o"], cwd=out, check=True)
0409:     loader = out / "libtlhybrid.so"
0410:     subprocess.run(["cc", "-O2", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-fPIC", "-shared", "-I", str(HYBRID), "-o", str(loader),
0411:                     str(HYBRID / "loader.c"), "-ldl"], check=True)
0412:     manifest = {"schema": 1, "original_elf_sha256": ctx.image.sha256, "blob_base": f"{BLOB_BASE:#x}",
0413:                 "hooks": [{k: (f"{v:#x}" if k == "original" else v) for k, v in h.items() if k != "expected"}
0414:                           for h in hooks],
0415:                 "runtime_imports": [n for n in missing if n not in copies],
0416:                 "runtime_copies": sorted(copies), "notes": notes}
0417:     manifest["standalone_residual"] = {
0418:         "schema": 1, "source_sha256": source_versions,
0419:         "original_imports": sorted((production_undefined - production_defined) & provided),
0420:         "runtime_library_imports": sorted((production_undefined - production_defined) & set(missing)),
0421:         "original_data_redirects": {k: v for k, v in data_redirects.items() if v},
0422:         "original_initializers_omitted": {k: v for k, v in omitted_initializers.items() if v},
0423:         "rtti_imports": sorted(n for n in production_undefined - production_defined if n.startswith(("_ZTI", "_ZTS"))),
0424:         "vtable_imports": sorted(n for n in production_undefined - production_defined if n.startswith("_ZTV")),
0425:         "standalone_link_closed": False,
0426:         "reason": "hybrid resolves original ELF addresses and omits original entrypoint/initialization; this is not a standalone game"}
0427:     (out / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=1))
0428:     if verbose:
0429:         print(f"blob {blob.relative_to(ROOT)}: {len(hooks)} hooks, {len(missing) - len(copies)} runtime imports, "
0430:               f"{len(copies)} copied library objects")
0431:         for note in notes:
0432:             print("  note:", note)
0433:     return blob, loader
0434: 
0435: 
0436: def stage_runtime(blob, loader):
0437:     """ld.so splits LD_PRELOAD on spaces and colons; the repository path has a space."""
0438:     payloads = [(Path(path), Path(path).read_bytes()) for path in (blob, loader)]
0439:     identity = hashlib.sha256()
0440:     for path, data in payloads:
0441:         identity.update(path.name.encode() + b"\0" + hashlib.sha256(data).digest())
0442:     # Separate immutable blob/loader pairs even within the same checkout.
0443:     runtime = toolchain.cache_dir() / "hybrid" / hashlib.sha1(str(ROOT).encode()).hexdigest()[:12] / identity.hexdigest()
0444:     runtime.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
0445:     staged = []
0446:     for path, data in payloads:
0447:         target = runtime / path.name
0448:         if not target.exists() or target.read_bytes() != data:
0449:             fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".stage-", dir=runtime)
0450:             try:
0451:                 with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as stream:
0452:                     stream.write(data)
0453:                 os.replace(temporary, target)
0454:             finally:
0455:                 Path(temporary).unlink(missing_ok=True)
0456:         staged.append(target)
0457:     for path in staged:
0458:         if re.search(r"[\s:]", str(path)):
0459:             raise SystemExit(f"runtime path unusable for LD_PRELOAD: {path}")
0460:     return staged
0461: 
0462: 
0463: def steam_runtime_fallback(game, env):
0464:     """Directory with links to the libraries the system lacks (libGLU on a bare
0465:     Fedora), taken from the game's own Steam runtime; None when nothing is missing.
0466:     Only the missing ones are linked so the system copies of the rest still win."""
0467:     result = subprocess.run(["ldd", str(game / "Torchlight.bin.x86_64")], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
0468:     missing = re.findall(r"^\s*(\S+) => not found", result.stdout, re.M)
0469:     if not missing:
0470:         return None
0471:     target = toolchain.cache_dir() / "hybrid" / "missing-libs"
0472:     target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
0473:     for name in missing:
0474:         found = [p for d in ("usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu", "lib/x86_64-linux-gnu")
0475:                  for p in [game / "steam-runtime" / d / name] if p.exists()]
0476:         if not found:
0477:             raise SystemExit(f"the game needs {name}: install it or put it into {target}")
0478:         link = target / name
0479:         if not link.exists():
0480:             link.symlink_to(found[0].resolve())
0481:     return target
0482: 
0483: 
0484: def game_env(blob, loader, extra=None, headless=False):
0485:     blob, loader = stage_runtime(blob, loader)
0486:     game = Path(os.environ.get("TORCHLIGHT_GAME_DIR", Path.home() / "Games/Torchlight/game"))
0487:     env = dict(os.environ)
0488:     if headless:
0489:         # Safety net: if the loader is not injected the game must not open a window.
0490:         for name in ("DISPLAY", "WAYLAND_DISPLAY", "XAUTHORITY"):
0491:             env.pop(name, None)
0492:         env["SDL_VIDEODRIVER"] = "offscreen"
0493:         env["SDL_AUDIODRIVER"] = "dummy"
0494:     env["LD_LIBRARY_PATH"] = f"{game / 'lib64'}:{game}" + (":" + env["LD_LIBRARY_PATH"] if env.get("LD_LIBRARY_PATH") else "")
0495:     fallback = steam_runtime_fallback(game, env)
0496:     if fallback:
0497:         env["LD_LIBRARY_PATH"] += f":{fallback}"
0498:     env["LD_PRELOAD"] = str(loader)
0499:     env["TLHYBRID_BLOB"] = str(blob)
0500:     env.update(extra or {})
0501:     return game, env
0502: 
0503: 
0504: def selftest(blob, loader, only=None, shards=None):
0505:     """Runs the blob's tests before main; only: test name prefix. Returns (code, report lines).
0506:     The tests are split over `shards` game processes running at once (OTL_SELFTEST_SHARDS,
0507:     by default up to 4); each process gets the whole timeout."""
0508:     shards = shards or int(os.environ.get("OTL_SELFTEST_SHARDS", "0")) or min(4, toolchain.jobs())
0509:     if shards < 1:
0510:         raise ValueError("selftest needs at least one shard")
0511:     extra = {"TLHYBRID_SELFTEST": "1"}
0512:     if only:
0513:         extra["TLHYBRID_FILTER"] = only
0514: 
0515:     game, env = game_env(blob, loader, extra, headless=True)  # stages the runtime once for all
0516:     if not only:
0517:         env.pop("TLHYBRID_FILTER", None)
0518: 
0519:     def run(index):
0520:         try:
0521:             return subprocess.run([str(game / "Torchlight.bin.x86_64")], cwd=game,
0522:                                   env={**env, "TLHYBRID_SHARD": f"{index}/{shards}"},
0523:                                   capture_output=True, text=True,
0524:                                   timeout=int(os.environ.get("OTL_SELFTEST_TIMEOUT", "120")))
0525:         except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
0526:             from types import SimpleNamespace
0527:             partial = error.stderr or ""
0528:             if isinstance(partial, bytes):
0529:                 partial = partial.decode(errors="replace")
0530:             return SimpleNamespace(returncode=2, stderr=partial +
0531:                                    f"\nselftest: shard {index}/{shards} timeout after {error.timeout} seconds\n")
0532:     code, report, ran, failed = 0, [], 0, 0
0533:     for result in toolchain.parallel_map(run, range(shards)):
0534:         # Loader lines plus the indented details tests log under a failure.
0535:         lines = [line for line in result.stderr.splitlines() if line.startswith(("tlhybrid:", "selftest:", "    "))]
0536:         summary = next((re.match(r"tlhybrid: (\d+) tests, (\d+) failed", l) for l in lines if " tests, " in l), None)
0537:         if not summary:
0538:             return 2, report + lines + [result.stderr[-2000:],
0539:                                         "selftest: complete loader report missing"]
0540:         shard_ran, shard_failed = int(summary.group(1)), int(summary.group(2))
0541:         expected_exit = 1 if shard_failed else 0
0542:         if result.returncode != expected_exit:
0543:             return 2, report + lines + [f"selftest: process exited {result.returncode}; report is not acceptance evidence"]
0544:         ran += shard_ran
0545:         failed += shard_failed
0546:         report += [l for l in lines if l is not summary.string]
0547:         code = max(code, result.returncode)
0548:     if not ran:
0549:         return 2, report + ["selftest: no tests executed"]
0550:     return code, report + [f"tlhybrid: {ran} tests, {failed} failed"]
0551: 
0552: 
0553: def main():
0554:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
0555:     sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
0556:     sub.add_parser("build")
0557:     sub.add_parser("selftest")
0558:     run = sub.add_parser("run")
0559:     run.add_argument("args", nargs="*")
0560:     args = parser.parse_args()
0561:     blob, loader = build()
0562:     if args.command == "build":
0563:         return 0
0564:     if args.command == "selftest":
0565:         code, report = selftest(blob, loader)
0566:         print("\n".join(report))
0567:         return code
0568:     game, env = game_env(blob, loader)
0569:     return subprocess.run([str(game / "Torchlight.bin.x86_64")] + args.args, cwd=game, env=env).returncode
0570: 
0571: 
0572: if __name__ == "__main__":
0573:     sys.exit(main())
